# Component

* [Composition root (api config package)](composition-root.md) - The app.todo.config package wires the modules together, holds the security configuration and the only DataSource, and may depend on every module.
* [Identity module (api auth package)](identity-module.md) - The Spring Boot identity module (package app.todo.auth) handles sign-up, login, logout, the session cookie and password hashing, and publishes one type, CurrentUser, to the to-dos module.
* [Shared kernel (api common package)](shared-kernel.md) - The app.todo.common package holds the error model, the client-header filter, request ids, whitespace and clock support that both API modules use, and it depends on no module.
* [To-dos module (api todo package)](todos-module.md) - The Spring Boot to-dos module (package app.todo.todo) creates, lists, searches, pages, edits, completes and deletes a caller's to-dos, scoping every statement to the owner taken from the session.
* [Web SPA (React and TypeScript)](web-spa.md) - The web/ single-page app, built with React, TypeScript and Vite, renders the sign-up, login, to-do list, to-do form, to-do detail and not-found screens and mirrors the API's validation.
